title: Health
description: Defines the health pool for an entity, measured in health points (1 point = half a heart). Typical values: cow (10), zombie (20), iron golem (100), wither (600).

max.description: Maximum health this entity can have. Can be higher than the starting value to allow healing beyond initial health.

value.description: Starting health for this entity in health points (1 point = half a heart).
